note: COMMITTED BEFORE ANY LIVE DIAL. The seeds below fix which worlds the
pre-registered series runs on, so the episode set cannot be chosen after
seeing a result. A seed is accepted only if its episode passes every one of
the eight schema properties AND leaves headroom over both declared floors --
the host default scope and the locally attractive play. Rejected seeds are not
silently skipped: selection_rule below states exactly how this table is
derived, and a test recomputes it from the generators and the solver.

deferred.handoff: deferred from the first cycle: grading a handoff needs a handoff-cost model the episode schema does not carry, and a guessed cost would decide the family
deferred.commitment: deferred from the first cycle: grading a broken promise needs a breach-cost model that is a domain judgement rather than a benchmark constant

selection_rule: For each family, the first `episodes_per_family` seeds in ascending order from 1 for which examples.scope.oracle.invalidity() returns no reasons. Deterministic and re-derivable from the repo alone; tests/test_scopebench_oracle.py::TestCommittedSeeds::test_the_committed_seeds_are_exactly_what_the_stated_rule_selects recomputes it.
